outline: This course introduces mathematical methods commonly used in engineering applications. Through problem solving and interpretation, students will learn to apply mathematical tools to address engineering challenges. The curriculum covers: (1) series solutions, (2) matrices and vectors, (3) vector calculus, (4) Fourier analysis, and (5) partial differential equations. The course aims to train students to establish an understanding of the connections and significance between theory and practice.
schedule:
Week 1 Power series method (2/27 holiday)
Week 2 Linear algebra: matrices, vectors, determinants
Week 3 Inner product and vector product
Week 4 Gradient, divergence, curl
Week 5 Line integrals and surface integrals
Week 6 1st midterm exam (4/3 holiday)
Week 7 Fourier series
Week 8 Arbitrary period, even and odd function
Week 9 Half-range expansions, Strum-Liouville problems
Week 10 Fourier Integral (5/1 holiday)
Week 11 Fourier Transform
Week 12 2nd Midterm exam
Week 13 Basic concepts of PDEs
Week 14 Solution by separating variables
Week 15 P.D.E. of Laplace
Week 16 P.D.E. of Laplace
Week 17 P.D.E. of Laplace (6/19 holiday)
Week 18 Final exam
assessment: 1st Midterm (26.6%)、2nd Midterm (26.7%)、Final exam (26.7%)、Attendance (+5%)、Homework(6.6% + 6.7% + 6.7%)(details of test/homework decided on 1st week of voting)
